caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal, carved relief-like composition featuring two seated female figures, one on the left and one on the right, each draped in brownish-gold robes. Both figures are positioned facing forward, with their outside arms raised and their inside arms resting on large, dark anchors situated near their legs. The figures have long hair and wear headbands or scarves. Between them, in the center upper portion of the composition, is a brown sailing ship with full sails, set against a blue sky or water background with flowing shapes suggesting waves or clouds. There are three large, uncolored circular cutouts in the drawing: one near each figure and one at the bottom center. A brownish-red ribbon or banner curves above the ship and beneath the upper edge. The background surrounding the main design is a light beige, and there is text along the bottom edge that reads: "DRAWN TO 1/2 FULL SIZE • ELMER. G. ANDERSON •".
title: Side Panel of a Fire Engine
